title: Hand-picked port candidates
intro: Open-source ports and remakes on GitHub (and a few elsewhere) checked against PortMaster's catalogue and the limits of Mali-blob firmwares: GLES only, OpenGL 2.1 at most through gl4es, no Vulkan, often 1 GB RAM and 640x480. Fit is 1 (out of reach) to 5 (straightforward). 'Not found' means searches of portmaster.games and its suggestions site found nothing; it is not proof the game is missing.

candidates.notes: The PortMaster suggestion says it already compiles fine with sdl1.2-compat. Lowest-effort item here. Upstream has had no commits since 2012, so expect to carry fixes yourself.

candidates.blockers: Mouse-heavy UI needs gptokeyb mouse mapping; Rust toolchain in the build
candidates.notes: Pure SDL2 with ARM32/ARM64 builds noted on the suggestion. Runs at 640x480, matching most target screens.

candidates.blockers: RTS box-select and scrolling on a d-pad or stick
candidates.notes: Hosted on SourceForge, not GitHub. Already packaged for aarch64 on OpenBSD, so ARM64 builds are known to work.

candidates.blockers: Confirm VanillaTD isn't already listed (VanillaRA is)
candidates.notes: Same codebase as the VanillaRA port already on PortMaster, so likely a quick sibling port.

candidates.blockers: 64-bit only since v25.12 (Dec 2025); no Linux release builds; dense mouse UI at 640x480; big maps on an RK3326 CPU
candidates.notes: Was 32-bit x86 only until v25.12, which is why it couldn't be ported before. Moved to SDL3 in v26.03.

candidates.render: SDL3; OpenGL ES 2.0, ES 3.0 or software renderer
candidates.blockers: Bundle SDL3; 3D speed on Mali-G31 untested
candidates.notes: The suggestion says there's no Linux target; that is no longer true. Worth updating the suggestion.

candidates.blockers: Needs the base game and Cleopatra; city-builder UI at 640x480
candidates.notes: Fork of the Julius/Augustus (Caesar III) lineage.

candidates.blockers: Boost and miniupnpc dependencies; renderer untested on gl4es
candidates.notes: SDL2 window, so plain gl4es should do; Westonpack not needed.

candidates.blockers: RAM on 1 GB devices; Jedi Outcast single player is rough upstream
candidates.notes: iortcw (same engine family with gl4es) is already on PortMaster, so the path is proven. Search coverage was thin; double-check it isn't listed.

candidates.game: Albion, Warcraft and other 90s DOS/Windows games
candidates.blockers: One binary per supported game; mouse-driven UIs
candidates.notes: Static recompiler by M-HT; ran on the GP2X Wiz historically, so CPU needs are low.

candidates.blockers: Needs your own GALE01 disc dump; AI-assisted port, so quality and legal need review before submission
candidates.notes: Already packaged for PortMaster firmwares (release of 2026-10-03), with a fix for AmberELEC's older PortMaster. Candidate for a catalogue submission.

candidates.blockers: Needs glibc 2.36+, SDL2_ttf and a GLES3 driver
candidates.notes: Only tested on H700 / Mali-G31. Older firmware bases may fail the glibc requirement.

candidates.runtime: Native, once the Linux build matures
candidates.blockers: Linux build is a community alpha (x86_64 AppImage); ARM untested
candidates.notes: Watch: the native Linux build only appeared in 2026.

candidates.runtime: gl4es or Westonpack, plus a .NET runtime
candidates.blockers: .NET memory use on 1 GB; GL path
candidates.data: Free mods; original data for some
candidates.notes: Vanilla Conquer is the lighter route to C&C and Red Alert on these devices.

candidates.blockers: Compute shaders on Mali-G31; dual-screen layout
candidates.notes: The GLES backend was built for Android (AYN Thor).
TR1 is already covered by OpenLara. Revisit if Westonpack gets OpenGL 3.

candidates.blockers: Needs Vulkan, which these devices don't have
candidates.notes: Now Vulkan-only, so out of reach.

Suggestion marked Complete; maintainers note performance is unplayable on current devices

runtimes.name: Westonpack (base)
runtimes.state: v0.2.6.1; ports reference it as weston_pkg_0.2
runtimes.unlocks: X11 and Wayland apps; OpenGL 2.1 through gl4es; OpenGL ES 3.2; emulated GLX, EGL and GBM
runtimes.limits: pixman renderer broken; drm backend can't be combined with gl4es; Unity and Wine experimental; OpenGL 3 only listed as possible future work
runtimes.cfw: Broad support on ArkOS, AmberELEC and Knulli. muOS: headless works with LIBGL_FB=1, drm mode has performance issues. Knulli on A133P: VirGL slow.

runtimes.name: crusty_glx_gl4es
runtimes.unlocks: GL 2.x desktop games over X11/GLX, such as box64'd Linux builds (Remnants of Naezith about 37 fps on an RG35XX H)
runtimes.limits: Decent speed and compatibility, not native
runtimes.cfw: Works on Mali-blob devices; the safe default

runtimes.name: crusty_x11egl
runtimes.unlocks: GLES apps that insist on X11/EGL; Unity Linux players after shader rewrites to GLSL ES 3.00 (Shogun Showdown, 20 Minutes Till Dawn)
runtimes.limits: Needs a GLES3 GPU, often ASTC textures; those Unity ports ran 14 to 30 fps on a 1 GB H700

runtimes.name: Mesapack (mesa_pkg_0.1)
runtimes.limits: LLVMPipe and Lavapipe are very slow; only light 2D GL3 or Vulkan apps are practical
runtimes.cfw: The only route for GL 3.3 or Vulkan candidates (TRX, The Force Engine, OpenTESArena), and too slow for them

runtimes.name: gl4es (standard use)
runtimes.state: Upstream ptitSeb/gl4es; PortMaster docs recommend LIBGL_ES=2, LIBGL_GL=21, LIBGL_FB=4
runtimes.unlocks: Desktop GL 1.5 to 2.1 on GLES2 hardware; most id Tech 3 and SDL+GL ports
runtimes.limits: No depth/stencil readback, no GL_FEEDBACK, no accum, NPOT only with GL_CLAMP, no multiple colour attachments
runtimes.cfw: The Mali blob on RK3326, RK3566 and H700 is GLES-only, so this is the main bridge

runtimes.name: gl4es rework in recent ports
runtimes.state: No single upstream release found; it's a pattern in 2026 port submissions
runtimes.unlocks: Ports ship their own patched gl4es plus tiny X11/GLX stand-ins drawing through SDL2, skipping Westonpack. Ittle Dew: no 55 MB runtime download, about 600 KB added
runtimes.limits: Fixes live in per-port copies and aren't shared until merged into a runtime
runtimes.cfw: Some launch scripts only enable gl4es when the firmware sets LIBGL_FB or LIBGL_ES and skip it where native GL exists; some force a conservative no-probe profile (LIBGL_NOTEST=1)

runtimes.name: PortMaster requirement tags
runtimes.state: Shown in the games list filter
runtimes.unlocks: power = CPU above RK3326; opengl = real desktop GL; 2gb / 4gb = RAM; hires = above 640x480; !lowres = won't run at 480x320
runtimes.cfw: Use these to tag new submissions

runtimes.name: Older PortMaster on AmberELEC
runtimes.limits: Lacks newer helper functions such as pm_platform_helper; launch scripts need fallbacks
